name: organizers
description: Organize related emails, understand what needs attention, and turn messages into action, with you approving the changes.

interface.longDescription:
Organize related emails and decide what to keep, clear away or act on.

Review routine mail in groups, understand requests and deadlines, and discuss individual messages or follow-up. Mail Organizer summarizes what matters and suggests handling; you can approve or change it before anything is changed.

Currently includes mail only. Uses existing connected tools; available actions depend on those connections.
defaultPrompt: Help me organize my inbox. Suggest related groups and ask before making changes.
